messages:
olivia (Growth): Heads up — finalizing the announce post today. Need final changelog link, docs URL, a one-line benchmark blurb, and webinar timing. @sam can you confirm the changelog PR and any rollout blockers? :rocket:

sam (Eng): On it. Changelog PR is merged but infra asked to confirm rollout windows. Pinged @matt for timing details.

matt (Product): Infra OK for a 2-phase rollout. Proposal: canary 10% for 30m, then full ramp. Planned start 09:30 PT -> full by 10:00 PT. Is marketing ok with that cadence?

olivia (Growth): We plan to publish blog + social at 10:15 and kick webinar at 11:00 — canary at 09:30 would overlap our prep. Can we shift canary earlier so marketing has a clean T+15?

sam (Eng): We can move it. New proposal: canary 09:15 PT (10%), monitor to 09:45, start full rollout at 10:00. I'll update the runbook and the deploy checklist.

kai (Docs): Docs PR for release notes and quickstart is ready: https://redwood.ai/docs/release-v2. Added migration notes and a short example prompts section. Would like marketing to review the examples for tone.

olivia (Growth): Thanks @kai — will review the quickstart. Maria, can you draft the benchmark blurb? Keep it tight: latency + cost impact.

maria (Marketing Lead): Draft: "Adaptive batching reduces per-token cost by ~32% on typical chat workloads; p99 latency ≈220ms at 4k context." I can add a simple graph. @sam can you confirm numbers & source?

sam (Eng): Numbers check out. Source: internal benchmark suite v3. Raw table:
```
workload    tokens/sec    p99
chat-4k     1200          220ms
batch-16    4500          180ms
```
Feel free to quote the suite name.

olivia (Growth): Good — that'll work. Where is the public changelog link?

sam (Eng): Public changelog: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/compare/v1.9...v2.0. I'll append a short blurb about deprecations in the PR.

matt (Product): Webinar confirmed for 11:00 PT, 45 mins. Speakers: @matt, @kai, @olivia. Landing page: https://redwood.ai/webinars/launch-v2 — please include signup link in the announce.

olivia (Growth): We'll include signup CTA. Final checklist for publish: docs link (kai), changelog (sam), benchmark blurb (maria), webinar signup (olivia). Who owns social at T+15?

maria (Marketing Lead): I'll run social. @olivia send the asset pack by 09:30 PT and I'll queue posts in Sprout/Social.

deploy-bot: notice: Canary rollout scheduled 4115559300 -> 4115559600 (planned 09:15–09:45 PT). Full rollout scheduled 4115559601 -> 4115563200 (start 10:00 PT). Monitor channels: #eng-oncall, #release-war-room.

sam (Eng): Thanks — I'll post the updated runbook and the deploy checklist in #release-war-room and add alert hooks to ping @eng-oncall + webhook for pager.

olivia (Growth): Great. I'll send the final announce draft in ~20m for quick sign-off. @kai if you have any doc phrasing changes DM me.

matt (Product): One ask — please include the rollback plan in the announce notes: default rollback to previous model and notify marketing via #marketing (cc @maria). Sam, can you add that to the runbook?

sam (Eng): Yep — added rollback step and alerting. Will call a manual rollback to previous stable if errors > 5% in first 15m.

olivia (Growth): Awesome. That's everything I needed. Thanks all — will post the draft shortly. :party_parrot:
